name: Kamaria
source:
Lady Kamaria is a Laor maiden working for [url=https://vndb.org/c165737]Duchess Bellaflor[/url]. The Duchess has made Kamaria a nanny to help various noblewomen. Kamaria and her friends, often compete with each other as to how high a nobleman they can seduce. Her Father is Lusanti and her mother is from the Shattered Kingdom, giving Kamaria an exotic presence at court. Her eyes are firmly on the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]Prince[/url] for some fun. While Kamaria has a good relationship with her father, she has a troubled relationship with her mother.
